#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>
#include <utility>

std::pair<int, int> documentAnalyser(const std::string& doc) {
    bool inside = false;
    bool prevLetter = false;
    int maxLen = 0;
    int curLen = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    
    for (char c : doc) {
        if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            prevLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            prevLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        } else if (std::isalpha(c)) {
            if (inside && !prevLetter) {
                wordCount++;
            } else if (!inside) {
                curLen++;
                if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
            }
            prevLetter = true;
        } else {
            prevLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        }
    }
    return {maxLen, wordCount};
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;
    auto res = documentAnalyser(s);
    std::cout << res.first << " " << res.second << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
